name: Matplotlib
description: Comprehensive library for creating static, animated and interactive visualizations in Python.
summary: Matplotlib allows AI for understanding code, getting ideas, and translating or proofreading your own comments and PR descriptions, provided the human contributor understands and verifies the output and discloses AI use in pull requests. AI-written PR summaries, autonomous bots or agents, low-value AI-generated contributions, and AI-generated PRs for good first issues are not allowed.

evidence.quote: Generative AI tools are evolving rapidly and can be helpful. As with any tool, the resulting contribution is the responsibility of the human contributor.
External AI tooling (e.g. bots, agents) directly interacting with the project; including creating issues, PRs or commenting on GitHub or Discourse.
Solving topics that you wouldn't be able to solve yourself without AI
Using AI output without ensuring that you fully understand the output or without verifying that it is the correct approach.

To ensure project health and preserve limited core developer capacity, we will flag and reject low-value contributions that we believe are AI generated. We may ban and/or report users to GitHub if they harm the project or its community through irresponsible use of AI.

Good first issues are intended to onboard newcomers with a genuine interest in improving Matplotlib, in the hopes that they will continue to participate in our development community; therefore, pull requests that are AI generated will be closed.
Describe if and how AI is used.

conditions.detail: AI Disclosure section in the PR template
You must be able to solve the topic without AI and remain responsible for the contribution
You must fully understand and verify AI output before submitting
No bots or agents may open PRs or push changes directly

rules.note: AI-assisted code is allowed only if you understand and verify it, can solve the topic yourself, disclose AI use in the PR, and no bot or agent submits it; AI-generated PRs for good first issues are closed and low-value AI-generated contributions may be rejected.
